summary: B2Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting its agreement to sell its 70% interest in the Fingold joint venture (owning exploration claims adjacent to Rupert Resources’ Ikkari Project in Northern Finland) to Agnico Eagle Mines Limited for US$325 million in cash. The remaining 30% holder, Aurion Resources, waived its right of first refusal. Proceeds will be used to strengthen finances, buy back shares under a normal course issuer bid, and for working capital. The transaction is subject to customary conditions and expected to close in April 2026. This is a straightforward cash sale of a non-operating asset with quick expected close; watch for any regulatory hurdles or financing contingencies.
